title: Can I MASTER Torpedo Chess?
summary: chess.com Torpedo Chess against online humans (1400-1600; he is ~1700 in it): pawns may always move one or two squares forward, not only from their start square. Goal: win five games; he wins game 1-3, then finishes with his fifth victory in game 6. En passant still applies to torpedo double-steps and he exploits it to freeze enemy pawns.
rules: A pawn may move one OR two squares straight forward from ANY rank (both squares must be empty); captures unchanged.

En passant can be applied against any two-square pawn advance, not just from the starting rank (1:55 'E5 here would just lose a pawn to en passant'; 8:24 'pawns can't move because they get captured en passant').
